overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structural MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, or histology. Imaging strongly suggests an aggressive adult-type diffuse glioma, but molecular status cannot be determined definitively from these fields alone. The integrated diagnosis follows WHO CNS5 compatibility using the predicted IDH-wildtype and grade 4 pattern.
